headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the board to issue pro rata contribution refunds to participating public entities when year-end reserves exceed projected needs.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 537.750 governing proration of claims during fund exhaustion and refunds of surplus reserves.

headings.title: Exclusions from risk management fund coverage
headings.reviewNote: Lists excluded claims from fund coverage including workers' compensation, fines, penal defense fees, internal disputes, and uncooperative members.

headings.title: Exhaustion of other applicable liability insurance
headings.reviewNote: Requires exhaustion of benefits under any other applicable liability insurance policy before fund payments can be made.

headings.title: Coverage for contractually obligated public entities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes coverage for third-party public entities when a participating entity is obligated by written contract pursuant to board rules.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 537.755 establishing coverage exclusions, insurance exhaustion rules, and contractual coverage authority.

headings.title: Maximum per-occurrence claim payout limit
headings.reviewNote: Caps total claim payments and settlements from the fund at two million dollars for any single occurrence.

headings.title: Annual inflation adjustment of occurrence limitation
headings.reviewNote: Directs annual adjustment of the single occurrence cap based on the implicit price deflator and publication in the Missouri Register.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 537.756 establishing the statutory single-occurrence claim limit and annual inflation adjustments.

headings.title: Dismissal of innocent sellers in stream of commerce
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes dismissal of defendants whose products liability is based solely on their status as non-manufacturing sellers.

headings.title: Requirement of another defendant for total recovery
headings.reviewNote: Conditions seller dismissal on having another defendant before the court from whom total recovery may be obtained.

headings.title: Motion timing and seller affidavit requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires dismissal motion with answer supported by sworn affidavit denying any liability beyond stream of commerce status.

headings.title: Discovery period and protective orders on non-seller issues
headings.reviewNote: Provides sixty days for discovery on seller issues and permits protective orders staying discovery on unrelated issues.

headings.title: Hearing and dismissal without prejudice
headings.reviewNote: Mandates dismissal without prejudice if no evidence is presented showing seller liability beyond status in commerce.

headings.title: Interlocutory status of dismissal order
headings.reviewNote: Makes seller dismissal orders interlocutory and subject to being set aside for good cause prior to final disposition.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 6 subsection headings for 537.762 governing innocent seller dismissals, supporting affidavits, discovery windows, and interlocutory status.

headings.title: Definition of state of the art
headings.reviewNote: Defines state of the art as dangerous product conditions that were unknown and not reasonably discoverable when marketed.

headings.title: Affirmative defense in failure to warn actions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes state of the art as a complete affirmative defense only in strict liability failure to warn actions.

headings.title: Preservation of negligence claims
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that state of the art defense does not bar or restrict common law negligence causes of action.

headings.title: Feasibility evidence unaffected
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that the section neither authorizes nor prohibits evidence of technological feasibility in product claims.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 537.764 defining state of the art and establishing it as an affirmative defense in failure to warn suits.

headings.title: Abolition of contributory fault and comparative fault adoption
headings.reviewNote: Abolishes contributory fault as a complete bar to recovery and applies pure comparative fault in products liability claims.

headings.title: Proportionate reduction of compensatory damages
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes defendants to plead and prove plaintiff fault to proportionately diminish compensatory damage awards.

headings.title: Categories of plaintiff fault in products liability
headings.reviewNote: Defines chargeable plaintiff fault including unanticipated use, known risk assumption, unreasonable care, and failure to mitigate.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 3 subsection headings for 537.765 establishing pure comparative fault and defining plaintiff fault categories in product liability.

headings.title: Citation of Business Premises Safety Act
headings.reviewNote: Provides the short title as the Business Premises Safety Act.

headings.title: Definitions for business premises safety
headings.reviewNote: Defines business (excluding commercial residential or lodging operations), criminal act, harmful act, injury, person, premises, and reasonable security measures.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 2 subsection headings for 537.785 establishing the citation and statutory definitions under the Business Premises Safety Act.

headings.title: Business duty regarding criminal or harmful acts
headings.reviewNote: Provides no duty to guard against criminal or harmful acts on premises unless the business knows or has reason to know they are occurring or reasonably likely and sufficient time exists to prevent them.

headings.title: Affirmative defenses for security measures and trespassers
headings.reviewNote: Establishes affirmative defenses for reasonable security measures, trespassing or felonious claimants, and closed business hours.

headings.title: Inadmissibility of subsequent remedial security measures
headings.reviewNote: Bars evidence of subsequent security measures to prove business negligence or feasibility.

headings.title: Preservation of existing common law defenses and immunities
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that the section creates no new business liabilities and preserves all available statutory and common law defenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 537.787 governing business premises liability standards, affirmative defenses, and subsequent remedial measures.

headings.title: Citation of Agritourism Promotion Act
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the short title as the Agritourism Promotion Act.

headings.title: Definitions for agritourism liability
headings.reviewNote: Defines agritourism activity, department, director, inherent risks of a registered agritourism activity, participant, registered agritourism activity, registered agritourism location, and registered agritourism operator.

headings.title: Mandatory warning sign placement and letter size
headings.reviewNote: Requires registered agritourism operators to post warning signs with one-inch lettering at activity locations.

headings.title: Contract warning notice requirement
headings.reviewNote: Requires inclusion of statutory liability warning notice in all written contracts for registered agritourism activities.

headings.title: Statutory warning notice text
headings.reviewNote: Sets forth mandatory warning language regarding participant assumption of inherent risks of agritourism activities.

headings.title: Written description of registered activity upon request
headings.reviewNote: Requires operators to provide participants upon request a written description of registered activities covered by liability limits.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked 4 subsection headings for 537.856 establishing warning sign specifications, contract clauses, and activity descriptions for agritourism.

headings.title: Immunity from liability for inherent risks of agritourism
headings.reviewNote: Shields registered agritourism operators from liability for participant injuries resulting from inherent risks when warning signs are posted.

headings.title: Exceptions to agritourism operator immunity
headings.reviewNote: Retains operator liability for willful or wanton conduct, failure to warn of known dangerous conditions, and lack of ordinary care.

headings.title: Affirmative defenses of assumed risk and warning disregard
headings.reviewNote: Establishes affirmative defenses of assumed risk, deliberate disregard of warnings, and unintended use of equipment, animals, or appliances; source text states 'registered tourism activity' and footnote notes 'were' appears for 'was*' in original rolls.
